title: GreenScreenpack (with glow)
description: Glow #00ff00 texture for lime concrete, doesnt care about lightning. Easy to use in image or video editor.
body:
GreenScreen resource pack for image/video editing.

Requirements:
  - [[FABRIC] cit-resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)/[FORGE] OptiFine

Replaces original lime concrete block texture with green screen, Lightning doesnt change anything. Texture will be always #00ff00 with or without light.
